ActionPlanTemplateAssignment.name: ActionPlanTemplateAssignment
ActionPlanTemplateAssignment.description: Represents a junction between an action plant template's version and the target object (Care Plan Template, Benefit, and Goal Definition) associated with them.

ActionPlanTemplateVersionId.description: Action plan template that’s mapped to a problem defintion, goal definition, or care plan template. This field is a relationship field.

AssociatedObjectId.description: The object to which the action plan template is associated. For example: a problem definition, goal definition, or care plan template, associated with an action plan template.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The date and time when the record was last viewed.

Name.description: The name of the action plan template assignment record.

IsApplicable.description: Indicates whether the action plan template assignment applies to the reference record (true) or not (false).

IsRequired.description: Indicates whether the action plan template assignment is required (true) or not (false).

Status.description: Specifies the status of the action plan template assignment.

TemplateDisplayOrder.description: The display order of the action plan template within the context of the reference record.

AssignmentQueueName.description: The name of the queue with ownership of the action plan records generated from the action plan template assignment.

AssignmentSize.description: The number of records to create for the assignment.

AssignmentType.description: The type of workflow to use for the assignment.

AssociatedRecordTypeId.description: The record type associated with the action plan template assignment.

ActionPlanTemplateAssignment.accessRules: In Health Cloud, this object is available in API version 56.0 and later.
